replies.author: Vobaseball12
replies.body:
Ok, here's my opinion on this.


A bit too bland. Add some more buildings, or wool of the color of the team in the lanes.


Get rid of the iron bars connecting around, it isn't worth it.


Make the wool room harder to get into. Add some soulsand, water, cobwebs, etc. I understand that defenses should be put up, but you gotta have a built-in first wave wool defense.


The wool room. Add some windows, and/or change the material the wool room is made of, it is just too bland. You need some POP of color in this map, it's way too dark. 


Make sure to add pictures of the wool room gear, spawn gear, etc. That will allow me to update this to talk about the gear.


TL;DR: Add some color, get rid of iron bars, add pre-built defenses, and show some pictures of the gear. Well done so far, don't give up!
